name: youtube-summary
description: Summarize a YouTube video from its transcript into a concise Markdown note, saved to a folder you configure or printed in chat.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize a YouTube video into a note
interface.longDescription: Fetches a YouTube video's transcript, writes a short TL;DR with key points and timestamps, and saves it as a Markdown note in the folder set by YOUTUBE_SUMMARY_DIR, or prints it in chat.
defaultPrompt: Use $youtube-summary to summarize this video without saving a note.
Use $youtube-summary to pull the key points and timestamps from this talk.
